card.name: Places where a Hall-type word may follow
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or letter just before where 'hall' could come next, such as 'City' in a list of governments or an 'H' starting a word. It also fires on a few ordinary words and commas inside symptom lists.

modes.label: City in government lists
modes.description: The word City in a list of local governments, where 'City Hall' could follow.
modes.example: | City of Seattle | City of Bellevue |<< City>> of Tacoma | King County

modes.label: Word-initial H
modes.description: A capital or lone H beginning a word after a dash or hyphen.
modes.example: 7 –<< H>>ANG THE BAG Hang the bag by

modes.label: Opioid and hyponatremia warnings
modes.description: The word 'a' or a comma inside stock warning sentences.
modes.example: Pinpoint pupils are<< a>> sign of opioid overdose but are not path

card.writes: It pushes the output toward 'hall' and 'Hall' (including Chinese 堂 and 厅) and away from 'all' forms.
card.plain: It is a weak, mixed signal that mostly nudges the model toward the word 'hall' after words like City.
